description:
Add streaming to the (now extracted) Anthropic Messages API client.

=== Scope ===
- Client::send_streaming(&self, &Request) -> Result<EventStream, Error> where EventStream: Iterator<Item = Result<Event, Error>>.
- SSE parser over the reqwest::blocking::Response body (BufRead). Blocking stays; concurrency is across adapter subprocesses (per ARCH §4.4), not within one.
- Typed Event enum covering Anthropic's native wire events: message_start, content_block_start, content_block_delta, content_block_stop, message_delta, message_stop, ping; plus Event::Unknown(serde_json::Value) catchall so future additions don't break the stream.
- Anthropic-native `error` events surface as Err(Error::Provider{..}) — reuses the non-streaming error path.
- accumulate(events: impl IntoIterator<Item = Result<Event, Error>>) -> Result<Response, Error> folds deltas back into the existing non-streaming Response shape.
- New Error::Sse(String) variant for malformed frames and truncated streams.
- anthropic-version stays "2023-06-01" (covers streaming).

=== Scope: NOT the adapter contract ===
This is the raw Anthropic wire parser used inside lernie-provider-anthropic. Ball #4 (bl-xxxx) adapts these events to the §4.4 normalized shape (text_delta / tool_use_delta / etc) and emits them from run_complete.

=== Testing ===
httpmock with text/event-stream body. Cases: well-formed text deltas; error event mid-flight; truncated stream (connection closed early); unknown event type; accumulator round-trips to a Response equal to the non-streaming parser's output. 100% tarpaulin on the new code.
title: Anthropic client: SSE streaming (raw)
